title: ST-GRU PredRNN-V2: A GRU-Based Reformulation of PredRNN-V2 for Video Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.18645v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video prediction requires models to capture complex spatiotemporal dependencies and to retain relevant information over long sequences. PredRNN and its successor PredRNN-V2 address this challenge with spatiotemporal Long Short-Term Memory (ST-LSTM) units that maintain two separate memory states, at the cost of a relatively complex recurrent building block. In this work, we investigate whether the simpler gating of Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) can be transferred to spatiotemporal predictive learning. To this end, we develop a spatiotemporal GRU (ST-GRU) unit as a GRU-based alternative to the ST-LSTM. The ST-GRU replaces the ST-LSTM's three gates per memory state with two GRU-style gates (update and reset), and merges the temporal memory state into the hidden state, which reduces the number of parameters by about 5%. We incorporate the ST-GRU into PredRNN-V2 and evaluate the resulting model on the Moving MNIST video prediction benchmark,

translated_title: ST-GRU PredRNN-V2：一种基于GRU的PredRNN-V2视频预测重构方法
translated_abstract: 视频预测要求模型能够捕捉复杂的时空依赖关系，并在长序列上保留相关信息。PredRNN及其后续版本PredRNN-V2通过时空长短期记忆（ST-LSTM）单元来应对这一挑战，该单元维护两个独立的记忆状态，但其代价是循环构建模块相对复杂。在本工作中，我们研究门控循环单元（GRU）更简单的门控机制能否迁移到时空预测学习中。为此，我们开发了一种时空GRU（ST-GRU）单元，作为ST-LSTM的基于GRU的替代方案。ST-GRU用两个GRU风格的门（更新门和重置门）取代了ST-LSTM中每个记忆状态的三个门，并将时间记忆状态合并到隐藏状态中，从而将参数数量减少约5%。我们将ST-GRU融入PredRNN-V2，并在Moving MNIST视频预测基准上评估了所得模型。
tldr: 本文提出了一种时空GRU（ST-GRU）单元，用更简单的双门控机制替代PredRNN-V2中复杂的ST-LSTM三重门结构并合并记忆状态，在减少约5%参数量的同时实现了视频预测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a spatiotemporal GRU (ST-GRU) unit that replaces PredRNN-V2's complex ST-LSTM triple-gate structure with simpler two-gate GRU-style gating while merging memory states, achieving video prediction with about 5% fewer parameters.
